text: Another important point is that macroscopic measures do not provide insight into potential fiber type-specific changes in muscle growth. Some strategies appear to promote greater hypertrophy in Type I or Type II fibers (40), which may indicate a synergistic benefit of combining various training approaches. Different training strategies also may elicit differences in exercise-induced sarcoplasmic versus myofibrillar hypertrophy (41). Thus, both site-specific imaging and histology are needed to derive a complete perspective on the impact of a training program on muscle development.
